name: AccessLint
description:
AccessLint monitors and scans websites for accessibility problems.

Most accessibility problems live behind an interaction. AccessLint saves user journeys that cross multiple pages and interactions, that a real browser replays and checks on a schedule. AccessLint can also scan a public page ad hoc against WCAG. In either case, it returns rich findings that you can dig into with Claude and file issues or spin up remediations.

What you can do:

- Scan a public page against WCAG and get the violations back.
- Turn plain sentences about user journeys, for example "search for a product and add it to the basket", into flows, with the steps compiled and auto-healed from the sentence.
- Look at the screenshot of the page as the browser saw it, at any step.
- Review the history and open accessibility violations a flow is currently finding

Requires a free AccessLint account. Single page scans work out of the box; you must verify ownership of a domain to run flows against it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AccessLint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AccessLint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.accesslint.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AccessLint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AccessLint lists 15 MCP tools, including add_domain, edit_flow_steps, generate_flows, get_draft, get_flow, get_run, get_scan, get_step_screenshot, list_domains, list_flows, list_violations, and revise_flow.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AccessLint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AccessLint in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
AccessLint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AccessLint is developed by AccessLint. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
